text:
chen: FYI rolling out release v3.4.1 in the 23:00-00:30 UTC change window. Cross-service list: API=v3.4.1, runtime=v2.7.0-rc3, console=v1.9.0, router=v5.2. Ask: any blockers? planning canary -> staged traffic -> full shift.
amelia: No blockers from product. Quick note: console migration flag needs to be enabled for a subset of orgs, will flip during canary.
simon: infra had a transient NVLink issue earlier today. I'm +1 on staged traffic but want a safety pin on runtime for Dedicated customers.
chen: Good call. Plan: pin runtime for dedicated to 2.6.8 during shift, route hosted to 2.7.0-rc3 canary. If errors >1.5% in 5m we auto-pause and fallback runtime->2.6.8.
javier: add me on rollback plan. Also ensure Router config includes header-based routing for canary.
chen: adding pinned config to the release notes block:
```yaml
pins:
  runtime: "2.6.8"   # Dedicated fallback
  api: "3.4.1"
  console: "1.9.0"
  router: "5.2"
canary:
  traffic_steps: [5, 20, 50]
  error_threshold_pct: 1.5
  window_mins: 5
```
deploy-bot: deploy started for api v3.4.1 | runtime rollout queued | console deploy scheduled 23:10 UTC | router rollout scheduled 23:05 UTC :rocket:
ops-oncall: tagging in case of SLO blips. I'll watch latency dashboards and token pump errors.
simon: confirm which regions get the earlier canary? prefer us-east then eu-west.
chen: yep us-east -> eu-west -> ap-south. router will shift headers per region.
deploy-bot: canary step 1 (5%) completed in us-east. No error deltas. CPU stable. :white_check_mark:
amelia: enabling console feature-flag for 10% orgs now.
deploy-bot: canary step 2 (20%) in us-east rolled. Monitoring... metrics nominal.
deploy-bot: alert :warning: runtime v2.7.0-rc3 observed 2xx->5xx spike at 23:18:12 UTC, error rate 3.9% over 2m in us-east.
ops-oncall: seeing increased KV cache misses and auth timeouts. Correlation with runtime change.
simon: pause the router shift, hold all further traffic steps.
chen: pausing rollout. Rolling back runtime in us-east to pinned 2.6.8 for Dedicated + hosted fallback.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: `deployctl rollback runtime --to 2.6.8 --zone=us-east-1 --selector=service=runtime`
deploy-bot: rollback complete in us-east, traffic restored to 2.6.8. Error rate dropping. :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: errors trending down but latency elevated for a few traces, investigating root cause for RC regression (KV compaction path?).
javier: can we capture a dump of a failing instance and compare kernels? I'll coordinate with eng-runtime.
amelia: console flag will remain at 10% until runtime stability confirmed.
simon: recommendation: keep api/console/router pinned for remaining regions and do a smaller runtime canary with additional observability. Also run the RC against our synthetic prompt set.
chen: agreed. New plan: revert to staged smoke with extra metrics, runtime RC canary to 2% first then 10%. No full shift until green for 30m window. Update release notes and change window to include hold.
deploy-bot: release paused. Please ack when you have action items.
chen: ack. I'll update the release doc and notify customers on the delay. Thanks everyone.
